Venkatesan, PGCIL Shri Rakesh Prasad, PGCIL Shri Jasbir Singh, PGCIL Shri Amit Kapur, Advocate, PKTCL # ** ORDER ** NTPC Limited (hereinafter referred to “Review Petitioner”) has filed the instant review petition under Section 94(1)(f) of the Electricity Act, 2003 (the Act) seeking review of the order dated 16.1.2017 in Petition No. 384/TT/2015, wherein the tariff was allowed for section of 400 kV (Quad) 2xS/C ParbatiKoldam Transmission Line (starting from LILO point of Parbati (Banala) Pooling Station to Koldam HEP) in Northern Region for 2014-19 period under Central Page **3** of **5** Order in Petition No. 16/RP/2017in Petition No.384/TT/2014 Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2014. 2. The Review Petitioner has submitted that PKTCL has claimed the COD of Ckt. I and Ckt. II of Parbati Koldam Transmission Line as 10.10.2014 and 4.10.2014 respectively under proviso (ii) of Regulation 4(3) of the 2014 Tariff Regulations. The Commission approved the COD of Ckt. I as 10.10.2014 as prayed by PKTCL, however the COD of Ckt. II was approved as 21.3.2015 as Ckt. II was put into use on 21.3.2015. The Review Petitioner submitted that the Commission as held that Ckt. II was put into use only on 21.3.2015 on account of delay in commissioning of the 400 kV bays in Koldam Switchyard of NTPC and imposed the liability of IDC and IEDC from 4.10.2014 to 20.3.2015. The Review Petitioner has submitted that it made certain submissions in the main petition on 14.7.2016 regarding the status on construction of the NTPC switchyard and the connectivity of Parbati-Koldam Transmission Line and the same was not considered by the Commission. The Review Petitioner has submitted that nonconsideration of the documents/information on record filed is an error apparent on the face of record necessitating review of the impugned order. 3. We direct issue of notice on the admissibility of the Review Petition. Page **4** of **5** Order in Petition No. 16/RP/2017in Petition No.384/TT/2014 4. The Review Petitioner is directed to serve a copy of the petition on the respondents by 26.5.2017 and respondents to file their reply by 16.6.2017 on admissibility as well as on merit and the petitioner to file rejoinder, if any, by 5.7.2017. No extension of time shall be granted. 5. The review petition shall be listed on 11.7.2015 for final hearing. sd/sd/sd/sd/- **Member Member Member Chairperson** Page **5** of **5** Order in Petition No. 16/RP/2017in Petition No.384/TT/2014
